from gurobipy import *

def solve_problem():
    # Create a new model
    m = Model("Optimization_Problem")

    # 2. Variables
    vars = {}
    lin_expr = 0
    vars['Var_0'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=6.91, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_0')
    lin_expr += 4.33 * vars['Var_0']
    vars['Var_1'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=10.56, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_1')
    lin_expr += 7.91 * vars['Var_1']
    vars['Var_2'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.2, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_2')
    lin_expr += 7.78 * vars['Var_2']
    vars['Var_3'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=16.71, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_3')
    lin_expr += 9.26 * vars['Var_3']
    vars['Var_4'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.59, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_4')
    lin_expr += 2.94 * vars['Var_4']
    vars['Var_5'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=19.57, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_5')
    lin_expr += 1.05 * vars['Var_5']
    vars['Var_6'] = m.addVar(lb=0.0, ub=11.43, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, name='Var_6')
    lin_expr += 1.7 * vars['Var_6']

    m.setObjective(lin_expr, GRB.MINIMIZE)

    # 3. Constraints
    m.addConstr(7.2 * vars['Var_0'] + -4.85 * vars['Var_2'] + 6.6 * vars['Var_3'] + -2.26 * vars['Var_5'] + 2.43 * vars['Var_6'] >= 38.79, name='C0')
    m.addConstr(6.9 * vars['Var_0'] + 1.13 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.72 * vars['Var_3'] + 6.07 * vars['Var_6'] >= 61.54, name='C1')
    m.addConstr(1.38 * vars['Var_0'] + -0.1 * vars['Var_1'] + -4.44 * vars['Var_2'] + -2.84 * vars['Var_4'] >= -56.57, name='C2')
    m.addConstr(3.48 * vars['Var_0'] + 4.1 * vars['Var_1'] + -0.52 * vars['Var_2'] + 0.87 * vars['Var_3'] + -2.56 * vars['Var_4'] + 8.17 * vars['Var_6'] >= 54.44, name='C3')

    # 4. Optimize
    m.optimize()
    return m
